images.author: Eric Lochtefeld
images.caption: Aerial picture, taken by drone, with permission by the Commissioner's Office.

facade.notes: Mercer County Courthouse (Celina OH, 1920s), drone view: a grey limestone Classical block with a giant colonnade, a flat roof with a skylit dome drum and rooftop units, on a full courthouse square of lawn, trees and a wide plaza walk; parking lots and low commercial blocks all around

why.note: the courthouse square: the county seat's courthouse on its own block, the stores facing it
